articles.title: This Robot Curls Up Like an Armadillo to Stay Safe
articles.summary: What if a robot could roll into a ball to protect itself? Engineers built one that copies the three-banded armadillo. When touched, it curls into a hard wheel in about a minute.

articles.title: Fat Bear Week: Vote for the Chubbiest Bear in Alaska!
articles.summary: It's Fat Bear Week! Every fall, people around the world vote for the fattest brown bear in Alaska's Katmai National Park. This year, 16 bears are competing — including a mom with three cubs.

articles.title: Meet Abhijay, a 14-Year-Old Who Teaches Kids to Code
articles.summary: Abhijay Potluri is 14 and already runs a nonprofit called Kids Who Teach. He teaches coding to kids in India, Indonesia, Uganda, and the U.S. — and he helped raise money for families after a fire near his home.
